summary: Sun Life Financial Inc. issued a news release (Form 6-K) cautioning shareholders about an unsolicited mini-tender offer from Ocehan LLC to buy up to 100,000 common shares at a price 24.97% below the August 27, 2026 TSX close and 24.93% below the NYSE close. Sun Life is not associated with Ocehan and does not endorse the offer; shareholders are not required to tender. The bidder structures the offer to avoid most Canadian and U.S. bid disclosure/procedural rules, with a 21-day withdrawal right. Watch for shareholder confusion and any regulatory response.
